method: long token-n-gram containment vs the exact tokenized Dolmino continuation corpus (inverted single streaming pass, no downsampling)
hash: 64-bit polynomial (Horner), P=1099511628211, mod 2^64; collision FP ~1e-4 total (negligible)
containment_def: |question n-grams present in training| / |question n-grams|; questions with <n tokens use their whole token sequence as one gram
verdict_rule: >= contam_high CONTAMINATED; < contam_low CLEAN; else PARTIAL
